title: One step of a register program
statement: Let $P$ be a register program, let an oracle assign a Boolean answer to each decider and finite Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$. Define one step as follows: if $c$ has no state, leave it unchanged. If its state has no associated call, take one ordinary transition of the program's underlying Turing machine; otherwise, form the virtual word specified by that call, the input, and the selected register words, query the oracle for the call's decider on that word, set the state to the call's positive-answer state or negative-answer state according to the answer, and reset the input-head position to $1$, leaving the other configuration fields unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A register program with $m$ work tapes, $d$ deciders, and state type $\Lambda$
